title: Experiment comparison report
description: New src/compare_experiments.py: aggregate reports/experiments/runs/*.json (12 runs) -> reports/experiments/comparison_report.md. Per cell (arch x strategy): mean+std over 3 seeds for acc, balanced accuracy, damaged recall, FN. Rank by balanced accuracy, tie-break damaged recall — NEVER plain accuracy. Flag rejected cells: damaged recall < 0.9158 baseline, or acc>=0.90 with damaged recall regression (rule violation). Declare winner cell + per-seed table + decision rationale. Val metrics only — test set still untouched.
acceptance_criteria: Report aggregates all 12 runs (2 arch x 2 strategy x 3 seeds)
Ranking uses balanced accuracy then damaged recall; plain accuracy never sole rank key
Cells with damaged recall < 0.9158 marked rejected
Winner cell declared with seed-level breakdown
Test metrics not referenced (test set untouched)
validation: ./.venv/bin/python src/compare_experiments.py --runs-dir reports/experiments/runs --output reports/experiments/comparison_report.md && ./.venv/bin/python -c "t=open('reports/experiments/comparison_report.md').read(); assert 'winner' in t.lower() and 'balanced' in t.lower(), 'missing winner/ranking'"
